# Parth Khansali

> Computer science student and software developer based in Dehradun, India. Developer of GEHU Connect, a campus networking app used by roughly a thousand students, and Netwich, a native macOS multi-interface network bonding utility.

## Identity
- Name: Parth Khansali
- Given Name: Parth
- Surname: Khansali
- Handle: @ParthKhansali
- Location: Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India
- Education: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering at Graphic Era Hill University (2024 to 2028)
- Role: Director General, Graphic Era Model United Nations Club (2024 to present)

## Main Projects
- [GEHU Connect](https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/gehu-connect/): Campus community mobile app (React Native, Expo, Java 21, Spring Boot, Redis, Cloudflare R2) used by roughly 1,000 students at GEHU.
- [Netwich](https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/netwich/): Native macOS 14+ link aggregator in Swift 6 and SwiftUI using a local SOCKS5 proxy and `IP_BOUND_IF` ([GitHub](https://github.com/ParthKhansali/Netwich)).
- [ARANYA](https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/aranya/): In-progress 3D CesiumJS geospatial wildlife conflict prototype piloted around Rajaji and Corbett in Uttarakhand ([GitHub](https://github.com/ParthKhansali/Project-Aranya)).
- [ORVESS-PAT](https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/orvess-pat/): In-progress optical tracking and FSOC simulation workbench in Python/PySide6 with a 640x480 FPA model and Adaptive-R EKF.
- [Meghavyuha](https://www.parthkhansali.tech/projects/meghavyuha/): In-progress SIH 2026 (SIH26080) probabilistic monsoon rainfall post-processing prototype built with Next.js and deck.gl ([meghavyuha.vercel.app](https://meghavyuha.vercel.app)).
